summary: Newmark Group filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, amending its existing $900 million unsecured senior revolving credit facility (expandable to $1.1 billion) and extending maturity to April 17, 2030. The facility bears interest at Term SOFR plus 1.125%-1.875% or base rate plus 0.125%-0.875%, depending on credit ratings. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is indicated.
